attempts.prompt: A clean, modern illustration of six simple male head silhouettes in a row, each outlined in a different face shape: oval, square, round, rectangular, diamond and triangle, with short neutral hairstyles. Soft neutral background, minimal labels under each silhouette, calm editorial style with no ranking or scores shown.
issues: Brief asks for simple head silhouettes, but the image shows six detailed, semi-realistic faces with full facial features, necks and shoulders, so the output does not match the requested minimal silhouette style.

The shape outlines do not consistently match the faces they label. The diamond outline is a rhombus drawn over a face that looks essentially the same as the others, and the triangle outline is an inverted wedge that does not follow the actual jaw or face contour.

All six faces appear to be nearly identical (same features, hair and proportions) with only the overlay changing, so the image does not actually illustrate distinct face shapes. This is a misleading transformation of the underlying anatomy.
Overlay outlines are loosely placed. The oval, rectangle and square extend over the hair, ears and forehead inconsistently, which reads as sloppy rather than as a clear editorial diagram.
Large empty space occupies the bottom ~40% of the canvas, leaving the composition unbalanced.
